info.name: Synology LDAP Manager
info.summary: Synology AD authentication, group sync and SMB/NFS storage — based on user_ldap patterns
info.description:
Full integration of Synology Active Directory into Nextcloud — no external dependency required.
Uses the same architecture as user_ldap (persistent user mapping table) for stable NC 33 compatibility.
**Features v3.0:** - Automatic AD group → Nextcloud group sync on each login (via user_ldap) - Automatic Nextcloud admin promotion via configurable AD group - Three transports: SMB with a service account, SMB with each user's own AD credentials (the NAS enforces its Windows ACLs at every level), or Local — for a Synology share already mounted over NFSv4 on the host (Docker / Nextcloud AIO) - Four mount modes: manual, auto by group name, auto by Synology ACL, and a common share visible by everyone - Active Directory auto-detection: reads the RootDSE and fills in the base DNs - ACL mode: reads actual permissions via Synology DSM API — each user sees exactly the folders allowed by their AD groups - Identical Windows / Nextcloud folder structure via Mount Prefix field (/NAS/Accounting, etc.) - Visual admin interface with real-time ACL preview and SMB configuration
info.author: wdebonne
